status.description: A contract_warning has priority over taste_nudge; no_finding means neither stage has a packet-grounded result.

evidence_seq.description: The visible tool-result sequence that grounds a finding; 0 only for no_finding.

anchor.description: The smallest exact implementation location that owns or reveals the gap: a code identifier, function, field, or state transition.

relationship.description: One short Traditional Chinese declarative observation or one precise question about one packet-grounded structural decision. A contract warning identifies an unmet task requirement or the one missing fact that keeps contract coverage open. A taste nudge identifies a concrete structural dependency and engineering consequence after the contract stage yields no warning. The Host renders the status marker, principle, and anchor separately.
